speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please describe the nature and location of your chest pain? Also, how long has the persistent vomiting been occurring?

speaker: Patient
text: 51-year-old male. The patient presents to the emergency department with persistent, forceful vomiting after consuming a significant amount of alcohol. His medical history includes recent treatment for Lyme disease with doxycycline. Recently, after a prolonged episode of retching, the patient starts to choke and cough forcefully, experiencing chest pain. The patient appears unable to communicate effectively at this point.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the history of forceful vomiting followed by chest pain, I suspect a Boerhaave syndrome. REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Free mediastinal air visible, suggesting perforation

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of free mediastinal air confirms esophageal perforation. DIAGNOSIS READY: Boerhaave syndrome
